summary: Israeli strikes in Gaza killed five Hamas operatives including October 7 participants, while Iraqi forces moved against Iran-backed Kataib Hezbollah in Jurf al-Sakhar and Iranian air defenses activated in Isfahan. The IDF demolished a West Bank home for rocket production and conducted a rare strike in Lebanon's Beqaa Valley. Bahrain warned of Iranian-backed Houthi threats amid rising regional tensions.
key_points: IDF killed five Hamas operatives in Gaza, including two in Jabalia and three in Rafah, citing systematic ceasefire violations. (Source: @manniefabian/59537)
Iraqi Prime Minister ordered army into Jurf al-Sakher to confront Kataib Hezbollah over oil smuggling, with CTS forces ready to storm the base. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10088, @shin_persian/12431)
Iranian air defenses activated in Isfahan city, per semi-official Mehr news agency. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10097)
IAF conducted rare strike in Lebanon's eastern Beqaa Valley near the Syrian border overnight. (Source: @manniefabian/59528)
IDF identified three Hamas operatives killed in Nasser Hospital strike, including an engineer involved in the October 7 abduction of Adina Moshe. (Source: @manniefabian/59529)
Bahrain's US Embassy warned Americans of heightened vigilance due to Iranian-supported Houthi attacks and Iranian targeting of US facilities. (Source: @shin_persian/12424)
Israeli troops apprehended two Lebanese brothers in Shebaa, while Nabatieh municipality restricted entry to eastern neighborhoods. (Source: @manniefabian/59527, @redlinkleb/53479)
IDF demolished home of Palestinian Abdullah Khatib in Ramallah for advancing rocket production in the West Bank. (Source: @manniefabian/59532)

sections.executive_summary: Israeli strikes in Gaza killed five Hamas operatives including October 7 participants, while Iraqi forces moved against Iran-backed Kataib Hezbollah in Jurf al-Sakhar and Iranian air defenses activated in Isfahan. The IDF demolished a West Bank home for rocket production and conducted a rare strike in Lebanon's Beqaa Valley. Bahrain warned of Iranian-backed Houthi threats amid rising regional tensions.

points: Iranian air defenses were activated in Isfahan city according to the semi-official Mehr news agency, indicating a perceived aerial threat. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10097)
An Iranian Basij member was shot dead in Sistan and Baluchestan province, with such attacks on Iranian forces occurring frequently in the area for months. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10083)

Bahrain's US Embassy issued a security alert warning of increased threat of armed attacks by Iranian-supported Houthis and Iranian efforts to target US government officials and facilities in the region. (Source: @shin_persian/12424)

The IDF demolished the home of Abdullah Khatib in the Ramallah area after he advanced rocket production for launches from the West Bank, calling it an unprecedented demolition due to the severity of the rocket terrorism threat. (Source: @manniefabian/59532)

Israeli troops apprehended two Lebanese brothers on the outskirts of Shebaa overnight, raiding and searching their home before taking them away; the IDF has not commented. (Source: @manniefabian/59527)

The Israeli Air Force carried out a rare strike in Lebanon's eastern Beqaa Valley near the Lebanon-Syria border overnight, intended to thwart unspecified threats according to Israeli security sources. (Source: @manniefabian/59528)

IDF strikes in Gaza killed five Hamas operatives: Momen Rizk al-Shandaghli and Mohammed Jihad Omar in Jabalia on Saturday, and Ramzi Abu Taim, Hussam Saleha (who invaded on October 7), and Nashat Awad in a separate Thursday strike, all accused of advancing attacks and restoring Hamas capabilities in violation of the ceasefire. (Source: @manniefabian/59537)

The IDF identified three Hamas operatives killed in last week's strike on Nasser Hospital in Khan Younis: Murad Tawfiq Mahmoud Abu Zarifa (engineering commander involved in abducting Adina Moshe on October 7), Khaled Osama Abu Anza (head of communications in Hamas intelligence operations), and Muhammad Nafed Abu Awwad (Nukhba Force operative). (Source: @manniefabian/59529)

A car-ramming incident near Tapuah Junction in the West Bank caused two settlers minor injuries; the driver fled and the IDF is investigating, later assessing it as a violent confrontation between settlers and Palestinians in Yasuf village rather than a terror attack. (Source: @manniefabian/59535, @manniefabian/59536, @yediotnews25/137941)

The IDF demolished the home of Abdullah Khatib in Ramallah for advancing rocket production in the West Bank, part of a terror cell captured in September 2025 before executing any attacks. (Source: @manniefabian/59532)

Five Hamas operatives were killed in recent Gaza strikes, including platoon commanders and a Nukhba Force cell commander, with the IDF stating they were advancing attacks on troops and civilians and restoring Hamas capabilities in systematic ceasefire violation. (Source: @manniefabian/59537)

Three Hamas operatives were killed in a strike on Nasser Hospital in Khan Younis, including an engineering team commander who participated in the October 7 abduction of Adina Moshe, a Hamas intelligence communications head, and a Nukhba Force operative; Hamas reported six dead and at least 20 wounded. (Source: @manniefabian/59529)
An IDF drone dispersed leaflets in central Gaza City at the Al-Saraya junction, as shown in Palestinian social media footage. (Source: @yediotnews25/137934)

The IAF conducted a rare strike in Lebanon's eastern Beqaa Valley near the Lebanon-Syria border overnight, with Israeli security sources stating it was intended to thwart unspecified threats. (Source: @manniefabian/59528)

Israeli troops apprehended two Lebanese brothers on the outskirts of Shebaa, raiding their home and taking them away; Lebanon's National News Agency reported ransacking and damage. (Source: @manniefabian/59527)

Nabatieh al-Fawqa municipality issued a statement prohibiting entry to eastern neighborhoods (Al-Dair, Al-Bareed, Al-Aqida, Al-Manzala, Al-Hariq) due to the security situation, calling it a temporary measure until stability returns. (Source: @redlinkleb/53479)
A UNIFIL helicopter was observed flying over the sea off Tyre heading to the UNIFIL headquarters in Naqoura in the western sector. (Source: @redlinkleb/53509)
Drone flight was reported over Baalbek during the day, and an explosion was reported in Zoutar al-Sharqiya. (Source: @redlinkleb/53494, @redlinkleb/53521)

Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi ordered the army to enter Jurf al-Sakher, a stronghold of Iran-backed Kataib Hezbollah south of Baghdad, over alleged oil smuggling, setting a deadline for the group to leave. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10088)
Large numbers of Iraqi Counter-Terrorism Service (CTS) forces are reportedly ready to storm Jurf al-Sakhar if Kataib Hezbollah refuses to evacuate the base. (Source: @shin_persian/12431)

Per leaks to Al-Mada, IRGC-backed Kataib Hezbollah used six sites in Jurf al-Sakhar for oil refining and smuggling, including former Saddam-era military and chemical facilities; a government committee entered six sites. (Source: @shin_persian/12435)
An explosion was heard in Erbil Governorate, Iraq, according to reports. (Source: @shin_persian/12432)

Bahrain's US Embassy issued a security alert urging Americans to exercise heightened vigilance due to increased threat of armed attacks by Iranian-supported Houthis and Iranian efforts to target US officials and facilities, warning of potential alerts, flight cancellations, airspace closures, and travel disruptions. (Source: @shin_persian/12424)

Oil prices are falling as Strait of Hormuz shipments approach pre-war levels, with Brent trading near $95 a barrel after the IEA forecast a Q4 global supply surplus of 1.7 million bpd. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10080)

key_developments: Israeli strikes in Gaza killed five Hamas operatives including October 7 participants, with IDF citing systematic ceasefire violations and restoration of Hamas capabilities. (Source: @manniefabian/59537)

Iraqi government ordered army into Jurf al-Sakher to confront Iran-backed Kataib Hezbollah over oil smuggling, with CTS forces prepared to storm the base if the group refuses to evacuate. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10088, @shin_persian/12431)
Iranian air defenses activated in Isfahan city, signaling a perceived aerial threat and potential escalation. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10097)
IAF conducted rare strike in Lebanon's Beqaa Valley near Syrian border overnight, targeting unspecified objectives according to Israeli security sources. (Source: @manniefabian/59528)

IDF identified three Hamas operatives killed in Nasser Hospital strike, including an engineer involved in the October 7 abduction of Adina Moshe and a Hamas intelligence communications head. (Source: @manniefabian/59529)
Bahrain issued security alert warning of Iranian-backed Houthi attacks and Iranian targeting of US facilities, indicating regional threat expansion. (Source: @shin_persian/12424)

Israeli forces apprehended two Lebanese men in Shebaa while Nabatieh municipality restricted movement in eastern neighborhoods, reflecting heightened tension in southern Lebanon. (Source: @manniefabian/59527, @redlinkleb/53479)
sections.threat_assessment: Hamas continues to rebuild military capabilities in Gaza despite the ceasefire, evidenced by IDF strikes targeting senior operatives involved in October 7 and ongoing rocket production in the West Bank. Iraq's move against Kataib Hezbollah in Jurf al-Sakhar signals potential intra-Shia friction and a challenge to Iranian influence over oil smuggling networks. Iranian air defense activation in Isfahan and the Bahrain security alert suggest Tehran and its proxies are preparing for possible Israeli or US strikes, while the rare IAF strike in the Beqaa Valley indicates Israel is targeting supply lines to Hezbollah. The apprehension of Lebanese nationals in Shebaa and movement restrictions in Nabatieh reflect a deteriorating security environment along the Blue Line.
sections.regional_response: Iraq's deployment of CTS forces against an Iran-backed militia marks a significant assertion of state authority over Iranian proxies, potentially altering the balance of power in Baghdad's southern belts. Bahrain's alignment with US threat assessments demonstrates Gulf coordination on Iranian-backed Houthi risks, while falling oil prices amid restored Hormuz shipping suggest markets currently discount near-term conflict escalation. Lebanese municipal restrictions and UNIFIL activity indicate local communities and international forces are bracing for further instability. The IDF's home demolition in Ramallah for rocket-related offenses sets a new precedent for countering West Bank missile threats.
